answer: The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, expired if not renewed by fresh work, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Reaching the tundra of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The cipher is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the vine. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
